# lab backup

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
Back up zaphod's data that is not in git to marvin:~/backups/zaphod/<date>/.
  lab backup            one snapshot now (same as `lab backup run`)
  lab backup list       the snapshots on marvin
  lab backup install    run it every night at 04:17 (crontab; replaces the script's line). --dry-run shows it
What: hub/data (Open WebUI chats/uploads, Beszel, MLflow, ComfyUI, ...), llama-swap activity, all .env files
(mode 600). Not: model files (lab models gets them back), caches, Caddy certificates. Databases are copied
with SQLite's online backup, so services keep running. Keeps the last 14 snapshots; unchanged files are
hard links. Temporary until the NAS is rebuilt (setup/REBUILD.md section 6).
Good result: "copied N databases ... and N other files", then "== ... done: marvin:backups/zaphod/<date> (size)".
```

Usage:

```
lab backup [run|list|install [--dry-run]] [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --dry-run   install: show the crontab it would write, change nothing
```
